CustomField.label: Peak Usage
CustomField.formula: MAX( IF(API_Calls_Allocated__c > 0, BLANKVALUE(API_Calls_Consumed__c, 0) / API_Calls_Allocated__c, IF(BLANKVALUE(API_Calls_Consumed__c, 0) > 0, 1, 0)), IF(SOQL_Queries_Allocated__c > 0, BLANKVALUE(SOQL_Queries_Consumed__c, 0) / SOQL_Queries_Allocated__c, IF(BLANKVALUE(SOQL_Queries_Consumed__c, 0) > 0, 1, 0)), IF(DML_Operations_Allocated__c > 0, BLANKVALUE(DML_Operations_Consumed__c, 0) / DML_Operations_Allocated__c, IF(BLANKVALUE(DML_Operations_Consumed__c, 0) > 0, 1, 0)) )
CustomField.description: Usage of the most-used limit type as a share of its allocation. This is the figure the budget status is decided on, so it is the one to sort and report by. A zero allocation with any usage counts as full.
